comment: The licenses this repository accepts in the third-party code it carries outside samples/ (the platform's crates the FrontendBuilder package ships, and the tool sources and the distributed dx and wasm-bindgen), as approved by the repository owner. Only the owner adds to this file. The maintainer tool (libs/CodeBrix.WebPlatform.LibraryChecker) fails for anything else. Identifiers are SPDX license identifiers.

compiledIntoTheDistributedTools.comment: dx and wasm-bindgen are distributed as programs (the CodeBrix.WebPlatform.FrontendBuilder.<Platform> packages), so every crate compiled into them - on any of the five platforms - must satisfy the 'everywhere' tier, plus the exceptions below, plus a license accepted here for that crate BY NAME. PROVISIONAL, OWNER TO CONFIRM: 'exceptions' and 'bundledLicenseOverrides' below carry over, unchanged in effect, what the tooling tier accepted for these crates before the tools were distributed - LLVM-exception (target-lexicon, wasm-encoder 0.214, wasmparser 0.214 are 'Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception' only) and the CC-BY-4.0 file in browserslist-rs.

bundledLicenseOverrides.browserslist-rs: The crate's vendor/caniuse folder (the caniuse database, CC-BY-4.0, Copyright Alexis Deveria) is not compiled: the crate has no build script and includes none of it. The browser data dx uses is compiled in from browserslist-data (declared MIT), which was generated from that same caniuse database - credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-Dioxus.txt.

namedCrates.reason: Approved by the owner 2026-11-18: MPL-2.0 is accepted inside the distributed dx binary for exactly these crates, as an explicit exception, with a notice (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-Dioxus.txt) that says where their source is - the vendored, unmodified copy in this repository's tool vendor folder. The first twelve were approved 2026-11-18; smartstring (declared MPL-2.0+, pulled in by cargo-generate through rhai when dx's project templates came back) was approved 2026-11-19 as the thirteenth, on the same terms.
Approved by the owner 2026-11-18: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 is accepted for the crate webpki-roots only, by name (the Mozilla root certificate data, compiled into both tools).

tooling.zstd-sys: The bundled zstd C library is offered under BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only; BSD-3-Clause is elected. The GPL-2.0 text file in the crate is the other side of that choice and is not relied on.
tooling.petgraph: The crate's assets folder holds unused logo artwork under CC-BY-SA-4.0. No code is under that license and nothing compiles or displays the images.
